landing_description: Here you can create an advent calendar for someone you love or open a calendar someone has made for you
calendar_subtitle: 24 little joys to look forward to.
error_heading: The calendar could not be displayed
error_missing: We could not find this calendar.
error_unavailable: The calendar service is unavailable. Please try again later.
error_timeout: Loading the calendar took too long. Please try again later.
error_unauthorized: Please sign in to view this calendar.
error_forbidden: You do not have access to this calendar.
error_conflict: The request could not be completed. Please try again later.
error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
login_introduction: Sign in with your username and password.
login_failed: Could not sign in. Check your credentials. If a temporary password has expired, contact your administrator.
session_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
auth_unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Try again later.
auth_invalid: Check your details. The new password must meet the requirements and differ from your current password.
auth_forbidden: The request could not be authorized. Try again, or sign in again.
password_required: You are using a temporary password. Choose a new password, then sign in again.
password_change_help: Changing your password ends all your sessions. Sign in again afterwards.
password_policy_admin: Use 15–128 characters, including uppercase, lowercase and punctuation or a symbol. Avoid common passwords.
password_policy_user: Use 8–128 characters, including uppercase, lowercase and punctuation or a symbol. Avoid common passwords.
password_changed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
no_calendars: You do not have any calendars yet...
coming_later: These features are not available yet.
auth_error_heading: The page could not be displayed
admin_creation_help: Create an account for a verified recipient. Account creation does not grant calendar access.
admin_responsible_required: Select an existing responsible calendar administrator.
admin_no_responsible: No eligible calendar administrators are available. Create a calendar administrator first, then return to this form.
admin_responsibility_fixed: The original responsible administrator will be retained and must still hold the calendar administrator role.
admin_handover: Privately hand this password to the identity-verified recipient. It expires after 30 minutes and must be changed before ordinary use. The password will not be displayed again.
admin_invalid: Check the highlighted fields and the requirements for this operation. Refresh the account list if its details have changed.
admin_verify_required: Verify your current administrator password, then confirm the operation again. Your session deadline stays the same.
admin_verify_failed: Password verification failed. Check your password; after repeated failures, wait before trying again.
admin_username_conflict: This username is already reserved, including by disabled accounts. Choose another username.
admin_conflict: The operation could not be saved. The account may have changed, or the replacement password may match its current password. An administrator with attached ordinary users cannot be demoted; an original responsible administrator must still hold that role. Refresh the list before trying again.
admin_created: The account was created. It is shown on its list page below.
admin_saved: The change was saved. The account list is being refreshed.
admin_reset_effect: Resetting the password ends all of the recipient's sessions and replaces any earlier temporary password. Your own session remains active.
admin_disable_effect: Disabling this account ends its sessions and prevents sign-in. Disabling a calendar administrator leaves their users enabled.
admin_enable_effect: The account can sign in again with a valid credential. Previously revoked sessions remain revoked.
admin_promote_effect: Promotion requires a different administrator-compliant temporary password and ends all of the recipient's sessions. Responsibility remains fixed.
admin_demote_effect: This ends the recipient's sessions. Demotion is blocked while ordinary users are attached. An existing responsibility cannot be replaced.
admin_calendar_unavailable: Calendar creation is not available yet.
